Module sphere 

Source
Expand description

An external eye on the unit sphere: where the globe camera stands when the host places the eye.

Structs§

SphereEye 🔒
An eye in unit-sphere coordinates.
SpherePose 🔒
The map center and angles an eye on the sphere stands for.

Constants§

GAZE_REACH_HEIGHTS 🔒
How far along the gaze the center may lie, as a multiple of the eye’s height above the surface. A grazing gaze meets the surface near the horizon, and a center there would have the covering keep tiles near the horizon and drop the ground beneath the eye.
MISS_BLEND_RADII 🔒
Radii past the limb over which the center settles onto the point beneath the eye.

Functions§

first_surface_hit 🔒
Where a ray from origin along direction first meets the unit sphere.
gaze_center 🔒
Angular reach applies equally to hits and misses, so crossing the limb cannot move the loading center from nearby ground to the distant geometric horizon.
local_axes 🔒
Unit vectors east, north and up at a location, in unit-sphere coordinates.
missed_center 🔒
The center for a ray from origin along direction that misses the unit sphere: the limb point under the ray’s closest approach when the ray just misses, the point beneath the eye once it misses by more than a quarter radius, and a blend between.
